```{r}


library(tidyverse)
library(infer)
library(googlesheets4)
library(patchwork)
library(car)
library(estimability)
library(multcomp)




survey_stats = read_sheet("1lOjOhPeh4qqPBMC4nV7KXi0l73hdgoyUVs_J4-5yVXQ")

stats_condensed_major = survey_stats

stats_condensed_major$major[stats_condensed_major$major == "MCB"|stats_condensed_major$major == "Bio-Chem"] = "Bio"

stats_condensed_major$major[stats_condensed_major$major == "Chem-Climate"|stats_condensed_major$major == "CS-Climate"|stats_condensed_major$major == "Math-Climate"] = "Climate"

stats_condensed_major$major[stats_condensed_major$major == "Math-CS"] = "CS"

stats_condensed_major$major[stats_condensed_major$major == "Physics-CS"|stats_condensed_major$major == "Math-Physics"] = "Physics"


#let's visualize with the simplified majors for each question:


grad_vs_class = stats_condensed_major |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = class,
             y = grad_job_importance)) + 
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE,
               fill = "black",
               color = "grey12",
               linewidth = 1) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = major),
             position = position_jitterdodge())+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_y_discrete(breaks = c(2,4,6,8,10),
                   labels = c("2","4","6","8","10"))+
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Freshman",
                              "Sophomore",
                              "Junior",
                              "Senior"))+
  labs(x = "Class", 
       y = "Importance ( 10 = high )", 
       title = "How Important Future Career is by Class")+
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black"), 
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "white"),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "white"),
        plot.title = element_text(color = "white"),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "black"),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "white"),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "white"))
```

```{r}
# let's now see if each of these questions are significantly different by class :


obs_grad_stat = stats_condensed_major |> 
  specify(grad_job_importance~class) |> 
  hypothesise(null = "independence") |> 
  calculate(stat = "F")
  
null_grad_stat = stats_condensed_major |> 
  specify(grad_job_importance~class) |> 
  hypothesise(null = "independence") |> 
  generate(reps = 1000, type = "permute") |> 
  calculate(stat = "F")
  
  
visualize(null_grad_stat) + shade_p_value(obs_stat = obs_grad_stat,direction = "right")
get_p_value(null_grad_stat, obs_stat = obs_grad_stat, direction = "right") # p = .33


# stats for interest:

obs_interest_stat = stats_condensed_major |> 
  specify(interesting_material~class) |> 
  hypothesise(null = "independence") |> 
  calculate(stat = "F")
  
null_interest_stat = stats_condensed_major |> 
  specify(interesting_material~class) |> 
  hypothesise(null = "independence") |> 
  generate(reps = 1000, type = "permute") |> 
  calculate(stat = "F")
  
  
visualize(null_interest_stat) + shade_p_value(obs_stat = obs_interest_stat,direction = "right")
get_p_value(null_interest_stat, obs_stat = obs_interest_stat, direction = "right") #p = .162



# stats for enjoyment:

obs_enjoyment_stat = stats_condensed_major |> 
  specify(enjoy_college~class) |> 
  hypothesise(null = "independence") |> 
  calculate(stat = "F")
  
null_enjoyment_stat = stats_condensed_major |> 
  specify(enjoy_college~class) |> 
  hypothesise(null = "independence") |> 
  generate(reps = 1000, type = "permute") |> 
  calculate(stat = "F")
  
  
visualize(null_enjoyment_stat) + shade_p_value(obs_stat = obs_enjoyment_stat,direction = "right")
get_p_value(null_enjoyment_stat, obs_stat = obs_enjoyment_stat, direction = "right") # p = .03

#investigate further
options(contrasts = c('contr.sum', 'contr.poly'))
enjoyment_lm = lm(data = stats_condensed_major, formula = enjoy_college~class)
enjoyment_anova = car::Anova(enjoyment_lm, type = 3)
multcomp::glht(enjoyment_lm, linfct = mcp(class = "Tukey"))
```
